name: 28401 · Wilmington, NC
findings: ZIP 28401 (Wilmington) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28401 (Wilmington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28401 (Wilmington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
